title: Grey Cat The Flag 2024 Finals
description:
--EDIT--
This CTF will now be hosted on the 27th of July, time is TBC! We are unable to edit the dates on CTFTime currently.
--------

Grey Cat The Flag is a CTF hosted by NUS Greyhats in collaboration with National Cybersecurity R&D Labs.

We have both local and open categories!

We will host the onsite finals in Singapore, to which the top 20 local teams from the qualifiers will be invited.

A team can be considered a local team only if all its members participating in this CTF event are Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents (PR), or Long-term Pass holders.
prizes:
